name: Il Falconiere
address: Località San Martino a Bocena 370, Cortona, 52044

stay.name: Il Falconiere Relais & Spa

packages.name: Spa & Relaxation
packages.includes: Two nights in a Deluxe room with breakfast, welcome sparkling aperitif, a three-course dinner at the Michelin-starred restaurant (wine not included), 50-minute body massage, couples’ wine therapy, unlimited spa access
packages.when: October and November offers; tourist tax not mentioned

packages.name: Food and Wine lovers
packages.includes: Three nights in a double room, wine tour with three-course lunch and wine pairing, a tasting dinner with wine pairing at the Michelin-starred restaurant, dinner at Locanda del Molino with transfers, spa access

packages.name: Golf & Gastronomy
packages.includes: Three nights in a Deluxe room, welcome drink, a three-course gourmet dinner with selected wines (the hotel’s restaurant), two 18-hole green fees, Baracchi winery tour, spa access

stay.note: A 31-room Relais & Spa on a Tuscan estate near Cortona; the starred restaurant is run by the owners’ family.
